findings.rule: AC#1 (designer B-tracking acceptance_criteria[0]: 'Public mode … no second connection, no auth'); rules/web-realtime.md#single-hub-singleton
findings.title: useFleetHub() runs in public/none (logged-out) mode -> doomed authed /hubs/fleet connect loop
findings.detail: TrackingPage calls useTrackingAuthed() in EVERY mode to satisfy rules-of-hooks (correct), but useTrackingAuthed() calls useFleetHub() unconditionally (line 58). /c never mounted the hub before, so in public or none mode (logged-out SMS-link recipient) hubInstance is null and useFleetHub's effect builds a /hubs/fleet connection and runs attemptStart() with a NULL access token (authStorage.getAccessToken() returns null when logged out). /hubs/fleet is [Authorize] (verified designer note + backend line 38), so the negotiate 401s, enters the cold-start retry loop (getReconnectDelay backoff), and keeps retrying a connection it can never establish — on a logged-out device, for the whole time the public tracker is open. This violates AC#1's explicit 'no auth' requirement for public mode. It is the OTHER half of the single-hub requirement I initially only half-checked ('no 2nd connection' is true; 'no auth' is violated). MITIGATION PRESENT (why not CRITICAL): it is user-INVISIBLE — the customer OfflineGate banner is driven by navigator.onLine (useOnlineStatus), NOT by the SignalR connection state, and no customer component consumes useConnectionState, so no spurious 'reconnecting/offline' banner appears; the 10s public poll works unaffected. No data-correctness or security/tenant impact (a null-token connect is simply rejected). Cost is wasted network churn + battery (repeated failing negotiate requests with backoff) on logged-out devices, and a standing AC#1 contract violation on the shared realtime path.
findings.recommendation: Gate the hub to authed mode: call useFleetHub() only when the tracking mode is 'authed'. Because useFleetHub must still obey rules-of-hooks, do NOT wrap the hook call in a condition; instead pass an 'enabled'/mode flag into useTrackingAuthed (it already receives an empty code in non-authed mode) and have useFleetHub early-return from its effect when not enabled (e.g. add an enabled param: `useEffect(() => { if (!enabled || hubInstance) return; ... }, [enabled, ...])`). Add a test: public/none mode does NOT create a hub connection (assert createHubConnection / connection.start not called). Verify the dispatcher/driver callers still pass enabled=true (or default true) so no regression.

(2) Shared useFleetHub.ts OrderChanged change is strictly ADDITIVE (stale guard first, list-cache logic unchanged, driver:orderChanged event intact, pre-existing detail invalidate preserved verbatim, only a setQueryData optimistic patch added before it; patched fields are a subset of OrderDetailDto) — NOT a dispatcher/driver regression; customer Subscribe reuses the single singleton (no 2nd HubConnection). (6) PushPrompt permission-only + feature-detected jsdom-safe; TrackingMap lazy (leaflet only in TrackingMapInner chunk). (7) ETA deferral — see eta_verdict (acceptable, not a blocker). (8) i18n cs/en parity green (516=516, 0 gaps), formal 'vy'; no cross-feature imports; touch targets via theme.touchTargets.min; money formatCzk/czkGrouped cs-CZ; Windows case-collision avoided; no tsbuildinfo/dist/test-results staged.
eta_verdict: ACCEPTABLE FOLLOW-UP, NOT A BLOCKER. The 15s ETA-minute refresh timer was deliberately not built. Honest, source-grounded deferral: TrackOrderResponse.EtaMinutes is always null pre-06 (OSRM ETA is assignment 06), so a 15s refresh timer would be provably dead code today, and the operative designer handoff AC#2 lists only the 10s public poll with NO ETA-refresh test. The headline degrades gracefully: headlineRules.ts branches on vm.etaMinutes != null -> headline.assignedNoEta ('Řidič {name} je na cestě', omits '~min') when null, headline.assignedEta ('...přijede za ~{eta} min') when non-null — the eta path is pre-wired for 06. Does NOT break AC#2 (live tracking is satisfied by SignalR Subscribe + cache-patch + marker movement, all present). Developer correctly flagged the task-prose-vs-designer-AC conflict and resolved toward the source-of-truth designer AC. Recommend scheduling the ETA-refresh timer + test with assignment 06 when EtaMinutes becomes non-null.
